This '''combat-scout droid''' was a [[Droid/Legends|droid]] that was once lost in a desert [[Planet/Legends|planet]] until it encountered [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]], [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]] and a man mounted on a [[CRILOC Horse]]. Despite its combat-oriented programming, this droid merely wanted to greet the astonished droids instead of destroying them.

==Behind the scenes==
The combat scout droid was created by [[Roy Grinnell]] for the [[2010]] book ''[[Star Wars Art: Visions]]''. His artwork was entitled "Wait... The Droid Just Wants to Say Hello".

According to Grinnell, he wanted the droid to have Human-like characteristics such as a sad, lonesome and compassive look without looking fearsome.
